name: acorn-utilities
description: A collection of useful utility tools for designers.

scripts.watch:ui: nodemon --ext svelte,ts,js,scss,sass --watch src/ui --watch src/tools --watch src/types.ts --watch src/defaults.ts --watch src/message-handler.ts --watch index.html --watch vite.config.ui.ts --watch vite.config.shared.ts --exec "npm run build:ui"
scripts.watch:code: nodemon --ext ts,js --watch src/code --watch src/tools --watch src/types.ts --watch src/defaults.ts --watch src/message-handler.ts --watch vite.config.code.ts --watch vite.config.shared.ts --exec "npm run build:code"
scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:code && npm run build:ui
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:clean && npm run build:code:debug && npm run build:ui:debug
scripts.build:clean: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json
